command: set -e; APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk; test -f "$APK"; REMOTE=$(adb -s RFCT70L7E8J shell pm path link.localclimate.app | head -n1 | tr -d '\r' | sed 's/^package://'); test -n "$REMOTE"; rm -f /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk; adb -s RFCT70L7E8J pull "$REMOTE" /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk >/dev/null; LOCAL_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}'); INSTALLED_SHA=$(shasum -a 256 /tmp/lcl-installed-base.apk | awk '{print $1}'); echo LOCAL_APK_SHA256=$LOCAL_SHA; echo INSTALLED_APK_SHA256=$INSTALLED_SHA; test "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$INSTALLED_SHA"; echo APK_HASH_MATCH=true
